title: Greek Mythology
description: Items and mobs based from the Percy Jackson universe.
body:
A mod which adds things from the Percy jackson universe
This mod adds Zeus, A master bolt, demons from hell (nether), Bronze and celestail bronze complete with full armor sets and tools, also a mini temple to spawn in Zeus (Chest with spawn egg in roof of building)
This mod was originaly on curesforge but i was unable to take it out of experimantal, then i lost acceces to that account, so the FULL OFFICAL mod is now here.
Have fun!
